Hi Jenna and Alex,

- Lock down the regional billing footnote language so procurement has clear guidance for billing contacts and tax treatment per territory.
- Confirm SKU/AMI tagging approach for the US and EU regions (we plan to surface a single offering with regional metering footnotes).
- Agree high-level mutual action plan for co-sell enablement and field handoffs.

1) Jenna — can you share the minimum legal/finance language your procurement team needs in the AWS listing footnote? A short paragraph we can include is ideal.
2) Alex — does the reseller require separate AMI tagging per account or is a consolidated AMI sufficient for your deployment model?
3) Any specific compliance artifacts (SOC2, data processing addendum) you need linked from the offer page? We can add a "Trust & Compliance" link.

Proposed next steps:
- Jenna/Procurement: send draft footnote or redlines by EOD Thu (4/23).
- Redwood: we’ll prepare the footnote draft + sample SKU mapping and a 2-week co-sell enablement timeline.

If helpful I can put together a short mutual action plan doc with responsibilities and timelines — propose we use the attached co-sell-map.xlsx as the starting point.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this listed.

Best,

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the clear ask. A few points from procurement:
- We need explicit billing language that clarifies which entity will be invoiced (Acme Corp global parent vs regional subsidiaries) and whether AWS metering will be by region or centralized. A 2–3 sentence footnote is fine; sample below.
- We will also need SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA before accepting a private offer.
- On SKU/AMI: our ops team prefers separate AMI identifiers per region for audit purposes, but we can discuss tradeoffs vs a single global AMI if there are deployment constraints.

Draft footnote request (procurement-friendly):
"Redwood Inference offerings on AWS are billed through Redwood Inference, Inc. Invoices for usage-based charges will be issued to the corporate entity specified in the private offer and may reflect regional consumption for tax and regulatory reporting. For multi-entity customers, please confirm invoicing preferences with your procurement contact prior to purchase."

I’m attaching a short procurement questionnaire — answers there will help speed internal approvals. (attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf)

We can aim to get a formal list of legal/finance redlines by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
